props.text: Schedule Manager demo — EDITS ARE REAL: data.schedules is bound to the gateway's user schedules (system.user.getSchedules() + two synthetic demo shifts), and the onScheduleSave / onScheduleDelete scripts persist via system.user. Drag empty grid space to paint availability, drag a block's edge to resize, click a block to remove, edit the name (rename) or description, then Save. '+ New schedule' creates one from scratch; Delete asks twice. The strip under the grid answers 'active now? until when?' and the red line marks the current time.

config.script:
# Reference persistence: rebuild a BasicScheduleModel from the flat mirror
	# and write it to the gateway, then bump refreshTick so the binding refetches
	# and the component's dirty badge clears against the saved data. A rename
	# (event.oldName present) adds the new name first, then removes the old.
	from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.common.user.schedule import BasicScheduleModel
	s = event.schedule
	name = str(s.name)
	m = BasicScheduleModel()
	m.name = name
	m.description = str(s.description)
	m.observeHolidays = bool(s.observeHolidays)
	m.allDays = bool(s.allDays)
	for day in ['monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday']:
		setattr(m, day, bool(s[day]))
		setattr(m, day + 'Time', str(s[day + 'Time']))
	def add(model):
		try:
			system.user.addSchedule(model)
		except TypeError:
			system.user.addSchedule(name, model)
	old = getattr(event, 'oldName', None)
	try:
		if old and str(old) != name:
			add(m)
			system.user.removeSchedule(str(old))
			self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onScheduleSave renamed "' + str(old) + '" -> "' + name + '"'
		elif name in [str(n) for n in system.user.getScheduleNames()]:
			system.user.editSchedule(name, m)
			self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onScheduleSave persisted "' + name + '"'
		else:
			add(m)
			self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onScheduleSave created "' + name + '" (isNew=' + str(bool(event.isNew)) + ')'
	except Exception as e:
		self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onScheduleSave FAILED: ' + str(e)
	self.view.custom.refreshTick = self.view.custom.refreshTick + 1
